hypothesis.alternative: Receipt-time Binance spot and USD-M BBO dynamics add out-of-sample probability and after-cost economic value beyond the Round 27 Polymarket prior, Chainlink TWAP60, CLOB, and trade-only features.
hypothesis.null: The incremental Binance BBO overlay does not improve the matched out-of-sample model or executable after-cost economics beyond the Round 27 base feature view.
hypothesis.prior: Strong null. A large synchronized Polymarket-Binance study reported measurable quote response but no tradable out-of-sample edge after fees and slippage.

matched_ablation.exclusion_policy: A decision with unavailable or older-than-1000ms spot or USD-M BBO state is removed from both the base and augmented candidate populations.
matched_ablation.identity_policy: Each candidate pair must use byte-identical decision rows, condition labels, condition weights, market-prior offsets, role assignments, and execution scenarios.
matched_ablation.selection_policy: Hyperparameters use train and calibration only; model-family choice uses selection only; sealed access remains one-time and unchanged from Round 27.

promotion_gates.accuracy: Condition-weighted accuracy and balanced accuracy are reported; neither can promote alone.
promotion_gates.economic: The augmented candidate must improve source-bound after-cost net PnL and preserve every Round 27 execution, concentration, delay, drawdown, and confidence gate.
promotion_gates.minimum_population: All Round 27 train, calibration, selection, and sealed condition minima must still pass after matched BBO exclusions.
promotion_gates.probability: The augmented candidate must beat its same-family base candidate on condition-weighted log loss and Brier score, with paired condition-bootstrap 95 percent upper bounds below zero.
promotion_gates.robustness: Report ROC-AUC, calibration error, accepted coverage, source gaps, and latency sensitivity; positive point estimates without confidence and economic gates are rejected.
promotion_gates.sealed: No sealed access unless one exact persisted selection candidate passes all probability and economic gates.

research_basis.finding: Spot individual-symbol bookTicker pushes each best-bid or best-ask price or quantity update in real time but does not provide an exchange event timestamp, so only the local receipt clock is admissible for causal joining.

USD-M individual-symbol bookTicker is real time and carries event and transaction timestamps, best prices, and best quantities; RPI orders are excluded. Cross-venue joins still use the collector receipt clock.
A 2026 crypto microstructure study reports stable predictive importance for order flow, spread, and adverse-selection features, with conservative top-of-book taker and maker validation.

OpenMarket reports a 727-million-row synchronized Polymarket-Binance corpus, measurable quote response, and a null tradable out-of-sample result after stated costs; the market prior and matched economic gate therefore remain primary.
High forecasting scores for limit-order-book models do not necessarily imply actionable transactions, requiring execution-aware economic evaluation rather than prediction metrics alone.

source_clock_policy.causal_cutoff: strictly received before the one-second decision timestamp
source_clock_policy.futures_exchange_timestamps: audited metadata only; never used to order against spot or Polymarket
source_clock_policy.reconnect_or_gap: invalidate the affected venue epoch until a fresh valid BBO is observed

storage_policy.database: one atomic DuckDB overlay containing only the 96 incremental values and exact provenance
